newsitem.title: UK: Allied shares floored after "bought deal".
newsitem.headline: Allied shares floored after "bought deal".

text.p: Shares in Allied Carpets inched lower on Thursday after ABN Amro Hoare Govett executed a large bought deal, traders said.
The shares were off 2p at 279-1/2p by 1324 GMT in volume of 17-1/2 million shares.
Dealings by the brokerage accounted for 17.2 million shares. The trades involved selling 8.4 million shares at 275p and buying 8.8 million shares at 272-1/2p.
"We did a huge bought trade this morning," said a market maker at ABN Amro Hoare Govett. "That explains the turnover." --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
